explanation: The seed is stored as a local wall-clock string without a zone (the ISO string is cut to the minute). At 23:30 UTC the event is one hour later, i.e. 00:30 the next day, so the app labels it 'Tomorrow'. The behaviour depends on the hour and the zone of the machine.
fix: Create the seed with an explicit UTC timestamp and freeze the clock with cy.clock so the label does not depend on the time of the run.
